description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable class `ImmutableCacheLookupContext` which implements the `CacheLookupContext` interface. It encapsulates cache lookup context data, including optional headers and JSON field selectors, providing methods for creation, access, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableCacheLookupContext
classes.description: An immutable final class that implements CacheLookupContext, encapsulating optional DittoHeaders and JsonFieldSelector, with static factory method for creation and standard overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.
